chunks: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

key_terms.الرَّحِيمِ: The Most Merciful (one who shows specific mercy to believers)
key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: The Most Gracious (one who has abundant mercy)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning and significance of the Basmala in Surah Al-Fatiha?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the Basmala is regarded as the key to the Quran and a fundamental act of seeking divine assistance (istighatha) before commencing any deed. It establishes the theological premise that all blessings and actions derive their validity and success from Allah's infinite mercy, a concept deeply linked to the Imams' role as intermediaries of divine grace.
